info.description: The songbook chord box: a 4-6 fret window with a dot per fretted string, O/x markers above the nut, and an optional barre. Distinct from lesson.diagram (a stretch of neck, for scales/shapes/where-notes-live) — this one answers 'how do I hold this chord', which is the single most expected visual in a guitar lesson. Renders through ChordDiagram in client/src/components/lesson/ChordDiagram.tsx.

strings.description: Exactly six entries, one per string, each carrying its own `string` index (0-5). Fewer than six leaves the missing strings muted.

barreFret.description: Absolute fret of the barre. Omit for a chord with no barre. All three barre fields must be set together.

fretCount.description: How many frets the box shows. Default 5.

startFret.description: Override the fret shown at the top of the box. Omit to derive it: chords reachable inside the window start at the nut, higher shapes start at their lowest fretted note and get a '5fr'-style position label.

orientation.description: vertical = the songbook chord box (nut across the top, strings running down). horizontal rotates it so the neck runs left-to-right with the nut on the LEFT, matching lesson.diagram — use it when the lesson puts a chord box next to a fretboard diagram and the two must not disagree about which way the neck runs.
